name: What information should I gather before starting a 1031 Exchange for a multifamily property?

mainEntity.name: What information should I gather before starting a 1031 Exchange for a multifamily property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before initiating a 1031 Exchange, you should gather all relevant financial documents for your current multifamily property, including acquisition costs, depreciation schedules, and any capital improvements made. You'll also need a clear understanding of its current market value and your equity position. Furthermore, begin outlining your investment goals for a replacement property, including desired location, size, and income potential. This preparation allows us to effectively identify suitable replacement properties and coordinate with a Qualified Intermediary, streamlining the process for properties in areas like Broward and Palm Beach counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather financial documents for your current multifamily property, including acquisition costs and depreciation, and define your investment goals for a replacement property.
